Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The X-Men come together to defend humanity
with the superpowers of the Mutants!

 

We are introducing the June Update,
celebrating the addition of Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97 inspired theme.

 

To support this team of Super Heroes with superhuman abilities,
we’ve added New Uniforms for Cyclops, Storm, and Beast,
and a Tier-4 for Beast, a Super Hero with bestial destructive power who also serves as a scientist.

 

Additionally, Sunspot, who can absorb solar energy and harness it for his own power, 
joins MARVEL Future Fight with his Tier-3 powers ready to go.

 

Furthermore, Elite Gear has been newly added
to further enhance your heroes’ powers, and we’ve also prepared a Card Crafting Quest 
to help Agents craft Comic Cards that will make missions easier.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 

▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Sunspot <Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97>, 
who has superhuman speed, flight abilities,
and can burst with explosive power by absorbing solar energy.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 


▣ Three New Uniforms

 

To celebrate the Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97 inspired update,
three new uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Cyclops <Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97>, 
Storm <Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97>, and Beast <Marvel Animation’s X-Men ’97>.  
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the 
<June Update Celebration Event> 
and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 


▣ Beast Tier-4

 

Tier-4 advancement has been added to Beast,
a founding member of the X-Men, 
who possesses superhuman physical abilities and intelligence.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 


▣ Sunspot Tier-3

 

Exploding with extremely high temperatures and light,
Sunspot’s Tier-3 Ultimate skill will be hard for anyone to resist.

 

 

 

 

▣ Goliath, Yellowjacket, and Cassie Lang Potential Awakening & Transcendence


Goliath, Yellowjacket, and Cassie Lang will acquire
Potential Awakening & Transcendence through the June Update!
* The skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 


▣ New System [Elite Gear]

 

Elite Gear that further enhances your hero’s combat abilities has been added.

 

Utilize Elite Gear to make your hero more powerful
and set high scores across various contents!

 

▶ New Materials for Elite Gear

 

Two new materials [Power of Demiurge] and [Godstone] have been added to enhance Elite Gear.
- The new materials can be obtained from the Team Battle Arena Store and World Boss Legend & Legend+.
- The Power of Demiurge is used for level-ups, and Godstones are used for opening and breaking level limit.

 

▶ How to Unlock and Open Elite Gear

 

1. The conditions for unlocking Elite Gear are as follows.
- Requires Tier-4, Lv.80, +30 Basic Gear(4 types) Upgrades
* After fulfilling the above conditions, the steps to open the hero’s Elite Gear will be available.

 

 

2. Materials for each hero, Godstones, and Gold are required to unlock an Elite Gear.

 

 

Once you've unlocked an Elite Gear, it starts at level 1, 
and you will receive one initial gear Stat Point.
Level up your gear at the Manage Elite Gear screen.

 

 

▶ Enhancing Elite Gear

 

 

Level up your Elite Gear through the ‘Level Up Elite Gear’ button, 
and acquire points to enhance your gear.

 

Two types of Enhancement Points can be acquired when leveling up the gear.

 

① Normal Level Up: Acquire Gear Stat Point

 

Growth materials are used for normal level-ups, 
where one Gear Stat Point is acquired for each level-up.

 

 

- In the Normal Level Up section, you can specify the number of levels you’d like to increase at once.
* The maximum level of Elite Gear is 200.
* Gold and Power of Demiurge is always required to level up.
* Different materials are required for each level section.
[Main materials for each Level Up Section]
Mastery materials, Gear enhancement materials, Tier-2, Tier-3, Tier-4 Growth materials, Potential Transcendence materials, etc.

 

[Gear Stat Points]

 

 

Gear Stat Points can be used to enhance Gear Abilities.
All heroes have the same Gear Abilities.
Each ability can be enhanced up to level 100, with a stat increase of up to 10%-15%.
* Used Gear Stat Points can be reset.

 


② Level Limit Break: Acquire Specialization Stat Point 

 

When Elite Gear reaches a certain level, you can proceed with Level Limit Break.
Breakout the level to acquire ‘Specialization Stat Point’.

 

The Level Limit Break gauge must be filled to 100% for Level Limit Break to succeed.
The amount of gauge that is filled depends on whether the Level Limit Break is a 
Normal Success / Super Success / Perfect Success.

 


* Level Limit Break occurs at gear levels 40, 80, 120, 160, 180, and 190.
* Gold and Godstones are always required for Level Limit Break.
[Main materials for each Limit Break Section]
Mastery materials, Gear enhancement materials, Tier -2, Tier-3, Tier-4 Growth materials, Potential Transcendence materials, etc.

 

[Specialization Stat Point]

 

 

Specialization Stat Points are used to enhance Specialized Stats, 
with a maximum of 7 points available. 

 

The type of Elite Gear for each hero depends on their fighting style.
There are four types of Elite Gear.
- Sword of Bone, Chthon Scrolls, Serpent Crown, and Ebon Rose.

 

Each Elite Gear has a different set of Specialization Stats, with a total of four Specialization Stats.
* There are 3 common Specialization Stats and 1 unique Specialization Stat for each hero type.

 

The maximum level of Specialization Stats is 6, increasing by up to 10%-15% per effect.
You can distribute Specialization Stat Points to enhance the Specialization Stats of your choice.
* Distributed Specialization Stat Points can be reset.

 

 


▣ Card Crafting Quest


Get a better understanding of the Comic Card Crafting system
and progress through quests to acquire related rewards.

 

1. The Card Crafting Quest can only be completed once per account.
- Quest Unlock Conditions: Clear World Boss Legend ‘Knull’ 1 time
- Enter the quest through the Navigation or the Event Banner on the main screen.

 

 

2.  The card you choose in the Card Crafting Quest can be crafted up to 6 stars through the quest.

 

- The Comic Card selected for the quest cannot be changed to another Comic Card during the quest, and related assistance cannot be provided.
- Comic Cards acquired from the quest cannot be changed/sold/converted like regular Comic Cards, and cannot be used as materials.
- Comic Cards acquired in the quest can be added to the Collection.
- Artbook-themed Premium Comic Cards cannot be selected in the quest.

 

 

* Premium Boost Comic Card: Added with this update as an item that can be acquired by converting Premium Comic Cards.
It can be used as a Card Crafting material and change the Normal / Craft Options of Comic Cards.

 

* Recraft Ticket: This item allows you to change the color of the crafted star to any color you want.
However, please note the following.

 

1) When recrafting a card, the existing Craft Options may change.
(Example: When you use the Recraft Ticket 3★ item, the first to third Craft Options will be recrafted.)
2) Recraft Tickets can only be used on Premium Comic Cards that have at least the same number of ★s as the Recraft Ticket.
(Example: The Recraft Ticket 3★ item can only be used on 3-6 ★s crafted Premium Comic Cards.)
3) When using a Recraft Ticket, if the selected color is present on the selected Premium Comic Card, the color will be preserved, but the Craft Options will be reset.

 

(Example screen for using a Recraft Ticket)
1. Select a crafted Premium Comic Card to use the Recraft Ticket.
(Select ‘Amazing Spider-Man #605’ (Craft Color: ★★★★★★))

 

 

2. Select the color of the ★ in the first to third position to the color you want to change.
* For the Premium Comic Card in the example, where you want to use the Recraft Ticket 3★, You cannot select a blue ★ because all 3 colors of the ★ in the first to third position are blue.

 

 

 

 

* The first to third Craft Options have also been reset. Please keep this in mind when using the Recraft Ticket!

 


▣ New Artifacts

 

Exclusive Passive Skill Artifacts for Sunspot, Goliath, and Yellowjacket will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 
Please check the sale schedule in the game.

 

​​New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[June Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Update Hot Deals & New Products

 

▶ Update Hot Deal products have been added.


- Event Schedule: 
After the 6/3 Maintenance - 7/1 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 6/3 Maintenance - 7/1 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- The products below are available under the Update Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 

1. To celebrate the arrival of Sunspot, new Hot Deal products have been added to support growth.

 

 

2. A new product has been added to support faster enhancement for Elite Gear.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. A new button has been added to go directly to the Set Striker skill screen, 
when entering a battle with a Tier-4 hero that does not have a Striker set.

 

 

2. Team Battle Arena: A Cost Penalty feature has been added.
- Heroes with the Cost Penalty will have a higher cost than other heroes of the same native tier.
- Heroes with the Cost Penalty can be found in the Set Team screen.

 

 

3. Settings - Lab - Auto Hide UI feature has been added.
- This feature will apply automatically when a certain time has passed after rotating the camera manually.

 

 

4. New Trivia quizzes have been added in the Challenges - Daily Trivia.

 

5. The Tier of Captain America, Iron Man, and Black Widow that can be acquired when creating an account has been increased from 1★ to 6★.

 

6. When enchanting X of Sword from +0 to +1, selecting the [10], [50], and [Max] buttons 
will no longer exceed the number of free slots in your inventory.

 

7. Iron Man's Discount Uniform in Guided Quest has changed to Iron Man <Model Nil>.

 

8. The maximum applied stat of the ‘Decreased damage received’ effect has been decreased from 100% to 99.9%.

 

9. The ‘Decreased damage received’ effect will now be applied when the ‘Wall’ effect of the C.T.P. of Conquest is applied.

 

10. The background modelling for ‘Harlem, Manhattan’, ‘Near Stark Tower, Manhattan’, ‘Midtown, Manhattan’, and ‘Hell's Kitchen, Manhattan’ has been improved.

 

11. Messages are now displayed when the Battlefield Effects are activated during the Team Battle Arena battles.
* Battlefield Effect: In the Team Battle Arena, effects such as decreased Recovery Rate, ignore Damage Decrease, increased Chain Hit damage, and increased Skill Damage will activate after a certain time for faster combat progression.

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes


1. An error message indicating that you have logged in from another device appearing and the game crashing when playing Multiverse Invasion has been fixed.
- Please note that this does not mean that your account has been hacked, and the incorrect pop-up window was exposed for unknown reasons.


2. Not being able to move to the main lobby screen when tapping ‘OK’ in the information pop-up when there are rewards available after defeating all bosses in Timeline Survival has been fixed.


3. The Tier icon not displaying on the Team Battle Arena main screen and match history pop-up has been fixed.


4. Team Battle Arena not showing up in the Content Status Board occasionally has been fixed.


5. Some hero data not applying when replaying the Alliance Tournament has been fixed.

 

 

We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
